title: Safe, Persistent, and Evolving Agent Harness for Understanding Partially Observable Worlds
title_zh: 用于理解部分可观测世界的安全、持久且可演化智能体框架
abstract_en: Large language model agents can invoke tools fluently, but enterprise workflows demand more than selecting the right tools: actions must strictly comply with organizational policies, tool feedback often conceals hidden side effects under partial observability, and long-horizon tasks require persistent state tracking across multiple records. To address these challenges, we introduce E-Ledger, a multi-agent harness for safe and persistent execution. E-Ledger employs a code approval layer that checks every proposed action against policy before execution, and maintains a world ledger of verified hidden rules alongside evidence-backed dynamic state. Because hidden rules are typically unknown a priori, we further propose WorldAbduct, an abductive, world-model-driven harness evolution framework. WorldAbduct diagnoses execution trajectories across four complementary views (state consistency, world-observation gap, policy-gate correctness, and goal judgment) to hypothesize latent rules, and verifies them through targeted abductive interactions before integrating them into the ledger. On the enterprise benchmark World of Workflows, E-Ledger with WorldAbduct improves safe task completion across four LLM backbones, outperforming the strongest evolution baseline by 5--15 percentage points. Experiments in ScienceWorld and DiscoveryWorld further show that abductive harness evolution carries over to scientific environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/E-LEDGER-WorldAbduct.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型智能体虽能熟练调用工具，但企业工作流不仅要求选对工具，还要求所有操作严格遵守组织政策、在部分可观测条件下识别工具反馈所掩盖的副作用，并在长程任务中跨多条记录持续追踪状态。为此，本文提出 E-Ledger，一种面向安全、持久执行的多智能体框架。E-Ledger 通过代码审批层在执行前依据政策检查每个候选操作，同时利用世界账本（world ledger）维护经验证的隐藏规则及具有证据支持的动态状态。针对隐藏规则通常无法预先获知的问题，本文进一步提出 WorldAbduct，一种由溯因推理和世界模型驱动的框架演化方法。WorldAbduct 从状态一致性、世界—观测差距、政策门控正确性和目标判断四个互补视角诊断执行轨迹，推测潜在规则，再通过有针对性的溯因交互进行验证并将其写入账本。在企业级基准 World of Workflows 上，结合 WorldAbduct 的 E-Ledger 在四种 LLM 骨干模型上均提升了安全任务完成率，相较最强演化基线高出 5–15 个百分点。ScienceWorld 与 DiscoveryWorld 上的实验进一步表明，该框架的溯因演化能力可迁移至科学环境。
key_points_zh: 提出 E-Ledger 多智能体框架，通过代码审批层在工具执行前检查候选操作是否符合组织政策。
构建世界账本，统一保存经验证的隐藏规则与证据支持的动态状态，支持部分可观测环境中的长程状态追踪。
提出 WorldAbduct，从状态一致性、世界—观测差距、政策门控正确性和目标判断四个视角诊断轨迹并提出潜在规则。
通过针对性的溯因交互验证潜在规则，再将可信规则整合进账本，使智能体框架能够持续演化。
在 World of Workflows 上较最强演化基线提升 5–15 个百分点，并在 ScienceWorld、DiscoveryWorld 中展现跨科学环境的迁移能力。

llm_assessment.comment: The combination of policy-gated execution, persistent workflow state, trajectory diagnosis, and verified harness evolution directly addresses long-horizon agent operations.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作结合策略门控执行、持久工作流状态、轨迹诊断和经验证的框架演化，直接解决长程智能体运行问题。
